Hello! My name is Yareli Rosales. I am a sophomore Computer Science, Statistics and Data Science major with a Business and Management studies concentration.

I am interested in careers where business and technology intersect. In Data Science II, which I took with Professor Roith at St. Olaf College, I developed skills in data analysis and working with real-world datasets. This experience strengthened my interest in using data to support decision-making and solve practical problems.
